correctness.rationale: The journal theorem is exactly Theorem 3.7 (pp. 162-163) and assumes K commutes with T,U and SΛ commutes with T, not SΛ with U. Exact rational evaluation of S=diag(4,1), T=K=I, U=[[1,9/10],[9/10,1]] gives eigenvalues 1/10,19/10, ordinary bounds 1,4, and for f=(1,-2) mixed energy <ΛUf,ΛTf>=-1. This contradicts any positive lower controlled bound. Under additional pairwise commutation, c_- S≤T S U≤c_+ S with c_-=||T^-1||^-1||U^-1||^-1, c_+=||T||||U||, proving the sufficient two-sided transfer, not optimality.
